Hagane - Briefing Room
<Yotennai>, prophet of the Volkruss Cult, put into@motion the Coffin of Silent Death plan to destroy@<La Gias> by stopping time...
Masaki and the others and I stormed her lair to@stop it, and defeated her after a fierce battle.
However, the Giants appeared right afterward,@and we were forced to retreat.
The Giants...@I heard about them when I went to La Gias.
They were super-intelligent beings@that died out in ancient times, right?
And their lingering thoughts became <Volkruss>, right?
Yes. Kadum Hakam, king of the Giants, is the true@form of the three evil gods: Sarva Volkruss, god of@destruction; Ruzamuno Rasfitoto, god of harmony...
And Gizoss Gragios, god of creation. He came from@another world to ancient La Gias@through the Cross Gate...
And he gave wisdom to the humans living there@and ruled over them.
(Hey, hey, that last part sounds familiar.)
(It's like what Shana-Mia told us...)
Could it be that Kadum Hakam@built the Cross Gate...?
It's unknown.@This is my speculation, but to him, the Cross Gate@was merely a means of travel...
He may not know any other way to use it,@or for some reason,@he may be unable to.
In other words, who built the Cross Gate,@and for what purpose...
Why it was placed in La Gias,@and when that happened, remain a mystery.
So you kinda flubbed the interview?
Don't speak rudely to my master.
I didn't mean it like that.@Sorry, Amala, sweetie.
Drop the sweetie.
Oh my~ If you keep furrowing your brow like that,@you'll ruin that cute face of yours~
D-Don't say such foolish things.
(Uh... Was she always like this?)
(I couldn't have imagined a reaction@like that from the old Amala...)
Enough of this nonsense.@Go on, Shu Shirakawa.
Yes. There are a few things I managed@to learn from Kadum Hakam.
His true goal was to raise tough, intelligent@life forms with mighty strength and will,@able to overcome the trials to come...
And La Gias, a special closed-off space,@was apparently the ideal place for it.
But long ago, the people of La Gias gained wisdom@and power beyond his expectations, and some, seeking@still greater wisdom, rebelled against the Giants.
That grew into a war for the people of La Gias@to break free from the Giants' rule...@and in the end, the humans were victorious.
Then the grudge of the defeated Giants gave birth to@the evil gods, which brought all manner of disasters@for a very long time.
And after Kadum Hakam was revived?
La Gias was driven into even greater danger.@Even if they defeated him, his grudge became@the three evil gods...
And when those were defeated too, they would fuse@and revive as the Giant, so ordinary means@could never destroy him completely.
However, thanks to Masaki succeeding in@communicating with Cyfis, the spirit of wind,@an effective countermeasure came to light.
He used the Cybuster, possessed by the spirit,@to gather all the energy in the spirit world...
And with the power of the spirits, opposite to the@negative existence of the Giants,@he annihilated Kadum Hakam.
Amazing... Masaki did all that...
But the price was huge.
Yes... The spirit power in La Gias canceled out@with Kadum Hakam, dropping so low that even@<Masoukishin> operators can no longer sense it...
And engines that used spirit power,@starting with the Masoukishin and <Masouki>,@lost their functions.
So that's why Masaki said the Cybuster@doesn't have the spirits' protection now.
Some time after the battle with the Giants ended...@I investigated whether one could travel between@La Gias and the surface as before.
Because Yotennai had completely cut off the two@worlds, I tried to determine whether the connection@had been fully restored...
Or whether there were any@lingering effects.
But in the end, I couldn't open a safe gate,@so I decided to travel to the surface world@through the Cross Gate.
It was also to test, with the Imitation Ritual@Converter I developed...
Whether the Cybuster could move and fight@on the surface as it did before.
Well, we could fight...@but we've gotta charge up on malice,@and that comes with risks.
Kuro
It's like doing the exact opposite of when@we had the spirits' protection, meow...
I admit it's a stopgap measure.@We'll need to think of another way to improve it.
I'm counting on you. I don't wanna go into@the Cross Gate's boundary space again and again.
(Masaki asking Dr. Shirakawa for help...@Seems things have changed between those two.)
Um, what about the other Masoukishin and@Masouki operators who looked after us in La Gias...?
They're all doing fine. Yang Long, Tytti and Mio@are keeping watch on La Gias's Cross Gate.
Excuse me. Can I ask a question too?
Go ahead.
By any chance, did Kadum Hakam@have a glowing ring on his head?
He did... But how would you know that?
Well, actually...
I see...@Fureim and Kadum Hakam@have several things in common.
Shana-Mia
Could they be the same kind of being?
Seeing as your home world had a Cross Gate,@I'd say that's highly likely.
But the Fury's Kadum Hakam@sounds like a good guy.
Yeah, so some Giants side with humans, huh.
Your Highness Princess Shana-Mia, that was truly@fascinating. Coming to the surface was worth it.
If the Granteed Dracodeus, where Fureim's@soul dwells, has the power to seal@the Cross Gate...
That may have a great impact not only on@the surface, but on the future of La Gias.
An impact... meaning what?
I hope to find that out in this battle.
So you're gonna keep helping@the Steel Dragons?
Yes. Is that all right with you, Lüne?
Yeah. After seeing something like the Rabulpaila,@I can't just leave it alone.
Tou-Ya. To bring all this to an end, I will fight@enemies other than Gu-Landon's faction as well.
That may lead to awakening the power@to seal the Gate of Voda.
...Fine.
(If Cross Gates exist on planets with intelligent life,@and Kadum Hakam came out of one...)
(There may be others who,@like Fureim, live on@in some form.)
(Will they be our enemies or our allies...?)
Hagane - Commander's Office
Daniel
As for Princess Shana-Mia...@If it improves the chances of closing@the Cross Gate, I'll grant her request.
She'll be placed in the Steel Dragons' custody.@Try sealing it again once the situation is resolved.
Meanwhile, she will not be officially treated@as a member of the Fury's imperial family.
Miles
Sir!
Also, regarding Colonel Ginto Kitaumi,@I understand the circumstances.
We couldn't overlook actions that threw the@chain of command into confusion on the battlefield.
That's sound reasoning, but this is an emergency.@Your judgment wasn't wrong, but I'm deferring@Colonel Ginto Kitaumi's punishment.
Reinstate him at once.
Do you object?
To make effective use of a special force like@the Steel Dragons, narrow-minded decisions@in the field must be kept in check...
Those are the words you spoke, Chairman,@before I took up my post as fleet commander.
That's right.
I've kept them close to heart and done my best@to fulfill my duties, but...
My words had another meaning you haven't noticed.@That you yourself must never fall into@narrow-minded thinking.
The decisive battle with Gadisword is a race@against time. When speed matters more than polish,@we can't do without Colonel Ginto's experience.
...Understood.@I'll lift Colonel Ginto Kitaumi's confinement@and have him take command of the Hagane.
Good. Now, as for how the Federation@government is handling Rabulpaila...
That meeting made me miss mealtime entirely.@...Sorry for dragging you along too.
No.
Major Kai, has it been decided how@we're dealing with Rabulpaila?
Will we be handling the assault operation?
Hold on, the Major is about to have his meal.
No, if you don't mind me eating while I talk,@I'll tell you. There's no gag order on it.
Oh, then we'll go get the food.@Help me out, Despinis.
Yes, sir.
Now... negotiations are currently underway@between the Earth Federation Government@and Gadisword.
The Federation is demanding that Rabulpaila@be disarmed and handed over.
I can't imagine Herluga Izberga@would accept anything like that.
Right.@It's to buy time for the Federation Army to@prepare an operation to take Rabulpaila.
Meanwhile, we're to keep Rabulpaila under watch,@at a distance, so as not to provoke@Herluga and the others needlessly.
And the Cross Gate Watch Fleet?
They'll be standing by in space behind us.
Then what if Rabulpaila shows signs of a@space transfer or of firing the Zemon Mortar?
Then we attack all at once.@So far Gadisword hasn't made a move, but@we may end up storming Rabulpaila on our own.
...So it comes down to time and luck.
Yeah.
Major, I've brought your meal.
Thanks.
And drinks for everyone, too. Coffee and tea...@And this is for you, Yuuki.
Mineral water...?
Yes.@I thought this would be better than the tea here...
A sound judgment. Thank you.
Heheh,@Despinis knows what everyone likes.

...Give me a status report.
Eita
Captain...!
Azuki

Tetsuya
We've been waiting for you.@About two squads of mobile units appear to be@patrolling the area around Rabulpaila.
No other notable activity. This ship and the@Hiryu Custom are continuing surveillance outside@the estimated range of enemy anti-air weapons.
Understood.@XO, Operators, I'm sorry I worried you.
Not at all. If not for your decision back then,@Captain, we would have...

At a time like this!

Crystal Dragoon
All mobile units, launch!
Hmph, just that one dope? I don't like it.
It might be a decoy, or a trap...
I mean, what even is that thing?
Doesn't look like a <Choukijin> or a <Yokijin>.
That's Crystal Dragoon...@a minion of the <Dark Brain> we beat@in the Shura Revolt.
What's something like that doing showing up now?
Could it be out to avenge Dark Brain?
You'd think so, but it's been gathering Lamaris,@carrying off the Ares Geist... It's been up to@all sorts of things.
Whatever that bastard's scheming, I'll smash him!
Jinpu
Can you hear me, Akimi?
Like I explained, the Siebe Drive is only an@auxiliary. And this is just a test run, so don't@go cranking up the output carelessly.
But I can really feel the power boost.@The throttle response is way better.@What happens if we get closer to the Cross Gate?
Fairy
That's why we're collecting data now,@so we can predict it even a little.
That's the idea. Even if the output goes up,@the body's strength hasn't changed.@Don't do anything reckless.
Yeah, got it!
Can you hear me, Akemi?
Yes.
Roger, but the throttle response is so much@better... I wonder what'll happen if we get@even closer to the Cross Gate?
Roger!
Eleve 1 to all units.@I doubt Crystal Dragoon is alone.@Stay alert for reinforcements!
...I have drawn out the forces I needed.@It is time.
That bastard's running away?!
Multiple spatial distortions in the combat area!@Something's about to appear!
Enemy reinforcements!?
Lamaris?!
Why are they here of all places...!
Could it be that what was expelled@from the captured Ares Geist@was transferred here?
As if small-fry Lamaris could take us down!
No, that's not it.@The enemy wants them to make contact with us@so they'll activate.
I think so too.
Activate...?
Make them combine into Kana Types.@And in the end, I bet they mean to@create an Ida Type.
Ida's the code name for Lamaris@even bigger than the Kana, right?
Eleve 1 to all units!@Spread out and wipe out the Lamaris!@Before they can combine!
The Lamaris are starting to merge!
Tch, they combined!

Now of all times...! Prepare for anti-air interception!
Debudedabide
Bufufuu, getting plenty of good footage?
Debudedabide!!
You bastard, you're still alive?!
Hmhm, I was just a little careless that tiiime.@I am immortaaal!
Just a little careless...?@I'd say you got pretty thoroughly trashed.
Well, well, quite the illusion.
Chika
What is that thing?@Its looks and the way it talks are a joke.
Is that another of Dark Brain's minions?
Yes.@There's also a half-man, half-horse freak@called Skull Knight.
So they're all monsters?@It's not like this is a Halloween parade.
I've got no time to deal with you lot!@Gimme-da-plate, Feed-me-da-food,@Debudedabi-debuu!
Th-The Kana Types!
Just like Bro and Captain Aya said,@that thing's goal is...!
Let's go, Crystal Dragoon.
Understood.
Buhahahaha! Farewell!
Damn it, that bastard!
Eleve 1 to all units! Mop up the remaining enemies!
...The fusion... is not occurring...@Too many were destroyed... The balance collapsed?
The operation... has failed...
Crystal Dragoon is leaving the combat area!
All Lamaris in the combat area eliminated!
Maintain full alert in all directions.@Mobile units, return to the ship at once@and resupply.
Yes, sir. Recalling mobile units for resupply.
Commander. After that, this ship and the Hiryu@Custom will continue monitoring Rabulpaila.
...Very well.
Hagane - Hangar
So the fat bastard was still alive...!
I kinda had a feeling he might be.
Man, he sure doesn't know when to quit.
As ever, there seems to be no end of visitors@from other worlds here on the surface.
OK, Mysterious Scientist.@It's not like we came here by choice, you know?
Same here.
I'm not blaming you.@The cause is most likely this world's@<Cross Gate>, after all.
But I didn't go through it to reach@the <Endless Frontier>.
Indeed. Not everything is the Cross Gate's doing.
But that gate existed in the@<Endless Frontier> as well, you see.
Seemed like the one there and the one here@were different deals, though.
Still, I doubt they're entirely unrelated.@<Shadow Mirror>, who once attempted dimensional@transfer, despite all their twists and turns...
In the end, didn't they reach a world@where a Cross Gate exists?
One way or another, Haken and Aschen came@to this world too, so I'll admit it does@feel like some kind of fate.
...So among countless worlds, the link with@the Endless Frontier is especially strong?
But it's not like there's a set way to travel@there, like with <La Gias> before, right?
Yeah. Thanks to that, Aschen and I@have no way back for now.
By the way, Haken...@there's something I'd like to ask you.
What's that?
In the Endless Frontier, was there anyone@who might have been Kadum Hakam?
Who knows?@There were the <Einst>, who used the Cross Gate.
Aschen
Ain't no mention of Hakam's name in any@of the data I dug up over there, neither.
I see...
And I'll add that <Dark Brain> and its goons@are a bunch we first met over here.
Still, those guys...@They're focused on making more Lamaris.
Gather lots of Kana Types to create@an Ida Type... I wonder what comes after that.
We might not know that until we find@the Dark Iron Castle...
What's that?
That's where Dark Brain's goons hole up.
It's a huge mobile fortress with a space transfer@device, like <Rabulpaila>, right?
Yeah, according to Roa.@I haven't seen it myself yet, though.
From what you've said, its location@hasn't been pinpointed.
That's right. It's definitely hiding somewhere@in the Earth Sphere, but...
I wonder if it'll show up in front of us someday...
I'd like to find it before that happens.
By the way, Super Soul Saber seemed to be@running well. Did you do something to it?
Yes, we installed a Siebe Drive@as an auxiliary engine.
Seriously?!
Yes.@The closer it gets to the <Cross Gate>,@the higher its output goes.
And the Gate supplies it@with unlimited energy.
Of course, the machine itself couldn't take that,@so we've put a limiter on it...
Is it really okay to use@the Cross Gate's energy?
We know the risks... but so far, there's no problem.
That's not something I can approve of.
Eric
Which is why I'd like you to take a look at@Super Soul Saber's Siebe Drive, you see.
Wh-When did you get here...?!
Dr. Wan...
Do me this favor, won't you, little Shu?
What's with you? You're awfully familiar.
Oh, it's quite all right.@We go back a long way.
Is that true?
Yes.@Dr. Wan is one of Granzon's designers.
Ho ho ho.
(This man...?)
What do you say, little Shu?
Very well. Judging from Rabulpaila, it seems to@be used differently from the <Yotennai>@of the past, but...
I'll examine the Siebe Drive@for future reference.
Please do.@It's a mystery even to me.
Cross Gate Space
Rabulpaila Central Control Room
Herluga
Hmm... The Earthlings are surprisingly hard-line.
Reggiane
They've already responded to our answer?
I told them we'd need three days to disarm@and hand over Rabulpaila, and they replied@that they'd allow only one.
But that's just what you expected, isn't it?
It is. With one day, we can achieve our goal.@They've given us exactly the grace period we wanted.
Even so, the moments right before the deadline@will be dangerous.
True. That's where we try to outfox each other.@They must want to buy time until their own@preparations are ready...
Now, which of us will get the job done first?
